guide.summary: Public app on Clover App Market (app review, wait unknown; reports of 7 weeks to 4+ months); Sandbox only (testing) (self-serve, wait none).
guide.verdict: Easiest: sandbox-only work needs no approval. Hardest: a public App Market app needs account approval plus an app review with no published timeline, reportedly 7 weeks to 4+ months.

composio.note: Clover is in Composio's bring-your-own-OAuth-app group, so you supply your own client ID and secret in a custom auth config.

need_own_app.answer: Yes. Composio has no managed OAuth app for Clover, so you must create a Clover app and give Composio its client ID and secret.
reasons: Composio has no managed OAuth app for Clover
Your own app gives a dedicated quota and your branding on the consent screen
Your own app lets you set your own scopes

prerequisites.title: Global developer account
prerequisites.detail: Create a global developer account first; build and test on the sandbox before production.

prerequisites.title: Owner role
prerequisites.detail: Only an Owner can view and edit account settings and accept the Clover Developer Agreement.

prerequisites.title: Identity and business documents
prerequisites.detail: Individuals need a passport or driver's license and proof of home address. Companies need a 9-character EIN or Tax ID, plus proof of business address.

steps.title: Create global developer account and sandbox app
steps.detail: Sign up for a global developer account and create the app in the sandbox first.

steps.title: Prepare identity and company details
steps.detail: Draft a checklist of the fields and documents Clover asks for, matching names and addresses exactly.

steps.title: Submit production developer account
steps.detail: In Developer Settings > Info fill each section, accept the terms as Owner, and click Verify Your Account.

steps.title: Wait for account verification
steps.detail: If Clover asks for documents, upload them to the Clover Box folder within 10 business days. Never email them.
steps.done_when: Status shows Account Verified and a confirmation email arrives.

steps.title: Configure the production app
steps.detail: Set permissions, Site URL, and the OAuth URL in REST Configuration, and choose countries.

steps.title: Create Composio auth config
steps.detail: Create the auth config through Composio's API with your Clover client ID and secret, and copy the redirect URI from the Composio dashboard.

steps.title: Wait for app review
steps.detail: No timeline is published. If it drags on, contact Clover Developer Relations; reply to any rejection email for the reason.

traps.title: After a 429 response, the app must pause one
traps.detail: After a 429 response, the app must pause one second before making another API request.

traps.title: Review waits are open-ended
traps.detail: Clover publishes no timeline, and developers report 7 weeks to over 4 months of silence. Do not plan a launch date around it.

traps.title: Missing the 10-day document deadline
traps.detail: If you do not return requested documents within 10 business days, the application may be rejected.

traps.title: Every change is re-reviewed
traps.detail: Revisions to approved apps, including permissions and legal links, go to Developer Relations review.

traps.title: Rate limit of 16 requests per second per token
traps.detail: Exceeding it returns 429; pause one second, then back off exponentially.

traps.title: Package-name conflicts
traps.detail: APKs cannot be deleted once uploaded, so upload a newer APK or change the package name.

blockers.symptom: Verify your Developer Account banner in Production
blockers.what_it_means: Your production developer account is not yet verified, so the app approval process cannot start.
blockers.what_to_do: Submit the account from Developer Settings > Info and complete verification.
blockers.agent_can_help: Prepare the field and document checklist.

blockers.what_it_means: Clover may not state the reason up front.
blockers.what_to_do: Reply directly to the rejection email thread to prompt a reason.

open_questions: How long does an App Market app review take, and what exactly does it check? Ask Clover Developer Relations; the docs give no figure.
Which permissions trigger extra scrutiny? The docs list no sensitive scopes; ask Developer Relations.
Can an app that serves only your own merchants skip the App Market review? Not found; ask Developer Relations.
How long does production developer account verification take? Not published; ask Developer Relations.

evidence.question: G1

evidence.answer: Creating a production Clover app requires a production developer account, which is obtained through Developer account approval.

evidence.question: G2
evidence.quote: External POS apps using the REST Pay API are not available on the public Clover App market, but your Clover apps are visible to merchants using your integrated POS.
evidence.answer: External POS apps using the REST Pay API are not on the public Clover App market, but the apps are visible to merchants using the integrated POS.

evidence.question: G4
evidence.quote: To complete a payment on the Clover device, you must authorize your app to read merchant data from a Clover device.
evidence.answer: To complete a card-present payment on the Clover device, the app must be authorized to read Merchant data (the READ checkbox for Merchant).

evidence.question: G4
evidence.quote: If your app lets merchants create and use ECOMM_COMPAT card tokens for card-not-present (CNP) transactions, you must also configure your app for the Ecommerce API.
evidence.answer: For card-not-present transactions using ECOMM_COMPAT card tokens, the app must also enable online payments under the Ecommerce section and be configured for the Ecommerce API, in addition to the Merchant READ permission.

evidence.answer: Enter a name for the app in the App Name field.

evidence.answer: When creating the app, you select one or more countries where the app will be available to Clover merchants.

evidence.answer: Clicking Create opens the App Settings page for the new app.
